column2: Feeling sympathy with them, He expounded the Dharma of the Cundī Dhāraṇī, the heart of the mother of seven koṭi Buddhas.

column1: 「南謨颯哆南(一)三藐三勃陀俱胝南(二)怛姪他(三)唵折戾(四)主戾(五)准締(六)娑婆訶(七)」「若有比丘、比丘尼、優婆塞、優婆夷， 受持讀誦此陀羅尼滿八十萬遍， 無量劫來所造五無間等一切諸罪皆悉消滅，
column2: The Buddha then pronounced the mantra: namaḥ saptānāṁ samyak-saṁbuddha koṭināṁ | tad-yathā oṁ cale cule cundi svāhā || “If, among bhikṣus, bhikṣuṇīs, upāsakas, and upāsikās, there are those who uphold this dhāraṇī and recite it 800,000 times, their sins, such as the five rebellious sins accumulated over innumerable kalpas, will all be expunged.

column1: 所在生處皆得值遇諸佛菩薩，

column1: 所有資具隨意充足，

column1: 常為諸天之所守護。

column2: If there are good laymen and laywomen who keep reciting this dhāraṇī, their homes will not be ravaged by catastrophes or diseases.

column1: 諸有所作無不諧偶， 所說言語人皆信受。
column2: Their work will be smooth and harmonious, and others will believe and accept what they say.

column1: 若有誦此陀羅尼呪滿十萬遍， 夢中得見諸佛、菩薩、聲聞、緣覺， 自見口中吐出黑物。
column2: “If one has recited this dhāraṇī mantra 100,000 times, one will see in one's dreams Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, voice-hearers, or Pratyekabuddhas, and see oneself vomit black things.

column1: 「復次我今說此大陀羅尼所作之事。
column2: “Next, I will now explain the procedure for using this great dhāraṇī.

column2: According to your ability, decorate it with offerings of flowers, incense, banners, canopies, food, drink, lamps, and candles.

column1: 復呪香水散於四方上下， 以為結界。
column2: To mark the boundary, recite the mantra to perfumed water in a vessel and sprinkle it in all four directions, also up and down.

column2: Then place a vessel of perfumed water in the center and in each of the four corners of the maṇḍala.

column2: You, the mantra reciter, staying inside the maṇḍala, should face east, kneel on your right knee, and recite the mantra 1,080 times.

column1: 其香水瓶即便自轉。
column2: Afterward, the vessels of perfumed water should swivel by themselves.

column1: 叉手捧雜花， 呪千八遍， 散一鏡面；
column2: Next, hold a bunch of flowers in both hands, recite the mantra 1,080 times, and scatter them all on the face of a mirror.

column1: 隨請問法無不決了。

column1: 即便除差。
column2: Then the condition should be removed.

column1: 即亦除差。
column2: This should also remove the condition.

column1: 誦此呪， 無有賊盜惡獸等畏。

column1: 「復次有法， 常持此呪， 設有諍訟無不獲勝。
column2: “Another dharma is to keep reciting this mantra in order that you will win any disputes or lawsuits.

column1: 「復次有法， 若被繫閉枷鎖禁其身，

column1: 誦此呪者， 即得解脫。
column2: If he keeps reciting the mantra, he will be freed.

column1: 「復次有法， 若諸國土水旱不調、疫毒流行，

column1: 應以酥和胡麻、粳米，

column1: 或經七日七夜， 六時如是相續不絕，
column2: Repeat this procedure continuously day and night in the six periods for seven days and seven nights.

column1: 一切災疫悉皆消滅。
column2: All catastrophes or epidemics should thus be eliminated.

column2: “Moreover, this Great Cundī Dhāraṇī, the great illumination mantra, was pronounced by all Buddhas of the past, will be pronounced by all Buddhas of the future, and is pronounced by all Buddhas of the present.
